BLOB_EPOCH: blob-lane completion counter; starts at 0 and increments only when a B-lane segment is staged; O-lane segments reuse the current value without incrementing it
HOOK_GEN: per-segment emission counter starting at 1; increments once for every journal segment in order regardless of lane; never assign it from blob_epoch
CLEAN: driver status token when pipeline reports success
CARRY_IN: carry token propagated from merged wave bundle
STALE_CARRY: carry token mismatch when incremental delta is not applied
